category_title: Preschoolers with Autism and communication delays who exhibit physical aggression during activity transitions
minimal_context: Chris is in his pre-kindergarten classroom being asked to transition from playtime to a table activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Chris, it is time to clean up the toys and go to the table for our next activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have to follow the schedule. Please get up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Chris, you need to come back and transition to the table right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Engages in physical aggression by kicking and throwing items in the classroom)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Chris, it is time to clean up the toys and go to the table for our next activity.

STUDENT: No! (Drops to the floor)

TUTOR: We have to follow the schedule. Please get up.

STUDENT: (Elopes from the activity area)

TUTOR: Chris, you need to come back and transition to the table right now.

STUDENT: (Engages in physical aggression by kicking and throwing items in the classroom)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when Chris was instructed to transition to a non-preferred activity
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: engaging in hitting, kicking, and/or throwing items in the classroom with or without targeting another peer or adult in the room
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: delays the presentation of the non-preferred activity and obtains attention from adults and peers

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Say "no", will drop to the floor, or elope from activity
